question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fcd179e3a81c473893979df94e2cac8d87958f8fca5472d407e8bada3d89bf95.png]
solution:
The logic follows here is:

 
• The black dot & the open space is moving in anti-clockwise direction.
 
• The star and the letter S is moving in the clockwise direction.

The figure that will replace the question mark is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df6f2205787877010b8b1ead3cbb91d4cf8fb576f3f01c3fcefaaa0f43f26c0d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**
